fields.description: Issue includes editorials and satire focused on the upcoming Miami city election and warnings about voting, with repeated discussion of Florida Power & Light and franchise politics. Articles address courthouse construction contracts and inspection concerns, commentary on imported voters and electioneering, and a column on the "color line" describing employment of Black firemen on the Florida East Coast Railway and related labor issues. The issue also references Mississippi Valley flood relief efforts and Red Cross fundraising, and contains humorous features (e.g., "Little Geraldine," Captain Kidd/Greeby pieces) plus multiple paid political advertisements for city commissioner candidates.
